data.one_liner: Add a keyboard toolbar with Done, navigation arrows, and custom panels in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a floating toolbar in an Overlay for forms and input fields. It automatically handles field discovery, Prev/Next navigation, and scrolling focused fields into view without scroll hacks.
use_when: You need a Done or Submit button above the virtual keyboard in forms or lists.
You want automatic Previous and Next field navigation without manually managing FocusNodes.
You are integrating custom keyboards or number pads.
avoid_when: You are building a desktop-only application where virtual keyboards are not used.
strengths: Zero FocusNode setup required for basic usage with automatic field discovery.
Does not hijack scrolling or require setting resizeToAvoidBottomInset to false.
Supports theming via ThemeExtension and custom keyboards per field.
weaknesses: Relies on standard text editing and focus mechanics, which might require extra wiring for non-standard text inputs.
